title: LR Matrix Record (20 columns)
description: Literature Review matrix row per SOP §5B. Order matters — matches Excel column order exactly.

S. No..description: Continuous serial from 1, no gaps, no repeats. Header row = 1, first data = 2

File Name.description: Exact filename matching Database/ and metadata record

Title.description: Title as printed (same as metadata Title)

Author.description: Display form: First-Last joined with commas. E.g., "Pankaj Sharma, Tirthankar Patnaik"

Year.description: Year as printed (same as metadata Publication Year)

Journal.description: Journal name as printed (same as metadata Publication Title)

DOI.description: Full https://doi.org/... link, or blank if none

Objective.description: 40-70 words. Research questions, hypotheses, motivation from end of Introduction.

Methodology.description: 60-100 words with concrete specifics and reported statistics. Data, Methods, sample, period, variables, techniques.

Key Finding.description: 60-100 words with concrete specifics and reported statistics. Copy reported numbers; never invent.

Limitation.description: 30-60 words. If paper states none, summarise scope boundary honestly.

Theoretical Framework.description: Only frameworks the paper names or clearly applies, otherwise blank.

Tag 1 (Method).description: Method tag from paper (e.g., NARDL, QNARDL, SEM, Regression, Case Study)

Tag 2 (Type of Research).description: Research-type tag. New value 'Reference' for textbooks/teaching handouts.

Independent Variable.description: Main independent variable(s) as named in paper

Dependent Variable.description: Main dependent variable(s) as named in paper

Decision (For Me).description: Blank by default (keep-all). Only filled on explicit screening request.

Reason (For Me).description: Reason for decision. Blank by default.
